title: "About"
---

## Hi, I'm Juan

I'm a data analyst based in Miami, working in the cruise industry. At Royal
Caribbean Group I work on fleet deployment and itinerary planning, where a single
schedule change can affect ports, fuel, crew and guests at the same time. Most of
my day is spent pulling that information together in SQL, Python, Excel and
Power BI so the team can see the trade-offs clearly before making a call.

## How I got here

I started with a bachelor's degree in finance from Florida International
University, which gave me a solid base in financial modeling and economics.
Before the cruise industry, I worked at Parkland, where I built KPI reports, ran
root cause analysis on operational problems and helped develop pricing
strategies. I then moved to Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, working on
deployment and revenue analysis and building Tableau dashboards that revenue
and strategy teams used every week. That work led me to my current role at
Royal Caribbean Group.

## What I'm working toward

My goal is to move into data science and machine learning roles. Much of the
analysis I do today explains what happened and why. I want to get better at the
predictive side: building models that forecast demand, flag risks early and
help teams plan ahead instead of reacting. The master's program at Boston
University has given me hands-on practice with classification models, Apache
Spark, cloud computing on AWS and generative AI, and I apply those skills to
real problems whenever I can.

## Skills

- **Programming and data:** Python (pandas, PySpark, Plotly), SQL, Excel
- **Visualization:** Power BI, Tableau, Plotly
- **Cloud and tools:** AWS EC2, Apache Spark, Git and GitHub, Quarto
- **Methods:** data cleaning and modeling, classification (KNN, decision trees,
  random forests), forecasting, dashboard design
- **Languages:** English and Spanish
